question: Should Wave 2+ modular dashboard capabilities stay on a bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway roadmap, and which child capabilities should move to plugin or ClawHub distribution?
rationale: The issue proposes new product surface, persistent state, untrusted widget execution, install/registry trust, and role-gated visibility decisions that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor selective child work
options.body: Keep the roadmap open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage and security proof before merge.

options.title: Move optional pieces outward
options.body: Keep only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widget packs, skills, registry flows, or app bundles to ship through plugin or ClawHub paths.

options.title: Defer the roadmap
options.body: Pause or reject the Wave 2+ direction if maintainers do not want bundled modular dashboards as current product work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor selective child work
recommendation.body: Keep the roadmap open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage and security proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the strongest current-main history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab and descriptor seam that the roadmap would extend.
